name: node-microservice-template
description: Node.js microservices template for DevOps showcase

scripts.install:all: cd api-gateway && npm install && cd ../auth-service && npm install && cd ../backend-service && npm install
scripts.dev:all: concurrently "cd api-gateway && npm run dev" "cd auth-service && npm run dev" "cd backend-service && npm run dev"
scripts.test:all: cd api-gateway && npm test && cd ../auth-service && npm test && cd ../backend-service && npm test
